parameters.query:
SELECT id, numero_cliente, COALESCE(nome_cliente,'') AS nome_cliente, agendado_para, COALESCE(assunto,'') AS assunto,
  CASE
    WHEN NOT lembrete_2h_enviado
     AND agendado_para BETWEEN (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo') + INTERVAL '30 minutes'
                           AND (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo') + INTERVAL '2 hours 15 minutes'
      THEN '2h'
    WHEN NOT lembrete_24h_enviado
     AND agendado_para BETWEEN (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo') + INTERVAL '22 hours'
                           AND (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo') + INTERVAL '25 hours'
      THEN '24h'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS tipo_lembrete
FROM giulia_reunioes
WHERE status IN ('agendada','confirmada')
  AND agendado_para IS NOT NULL
  AND agendado_para > NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo'
  AND (
    (NOT lembrete_2h_enviado AND agendado_para <= (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo') + INTERVAL '2 hours 15 minutes')
    OR
    (NOT lembrete_24h_enviado AND agendado_para <= (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo') + INTERVAL '25 hours')
  )
LIMIT 10;
